guitar.evidence: Waddy Wachtel, a noted session/touring guitarist who played on Warren Zevon's records including 'Werewolves of London', has used Gibson Les Pauls and Telecasters, but no singularly iconic documented instrument tied to this specific song.

tone.target: bright jangly clean-crunch with slight edge
tone.profile: bright jangly clean-crunch with slight edge
tone.summary: A classic British combo sound (Vox/AC30 style) using light compression and a mild overdrive to achieve a bright, punchy, 70s-jangly crunch suitable for Zevon's upbeat rock style.
corrections: shift from mid-gain to cleaner jangly crunch
